name: Feral Attraction: Epilogue
source:
Now that you've won the heart (or, in Koey's case, friendship status) of your preferred character,  watch them develop into different mammals while they're in a relationship with you. Whether they change for better or for worse while being your partner is for you to find out!

A Visual Novel that is set after the endings that took place in Feral Attraction, with after stories for every main character from the previous title.

[Edited from [url=https://moontoon.itch.io/feral-attraction-epilogue]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
现在你已经赢得了你喜欢的角色的心（或者，在科伊的例子中，友谊地位），看着他们在与你建立关系时发展成不同的哺乳动物。当你成为你的伴侣时，他们的改变是好是坏，只有你自己去发现！

一部以《野性诱惑》结局为背景的视觉小说，前作中的每个主角都有后续故事。

[编辑自[url=https://moontoon.itch.io/feral-attraction-epilogue]Itch.io[/url]]
